likely_causes.cause: Float switch tripped or pan full
Secondary drain or pan issue inside the unit

homeowner_checks: Look for standing water under the air handler — do not step in water near electrical
If safe, clear the visible end of the drain line outdoors
Replace a soaked filter if water reached it
Turn the system Off if water is actively overflowing
tech_only: Opening the air handler to clear an internal trap
call_pro_when: Water returns after clearing the outdoor drain end, or you cannot reach the drain safely.
assumptions: condensate_leak may be missing until that sensor is installed; KB still explains the symptom
